title: You Can Uke It! Beginner and Intermediate
summary: You Can Uke It! Beginner and Intermediate
description: Register Here Starting August 11! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. September 17 – November 5, 2025 Wednesdays | 4:30 – 5:30 pm | Ages 8-14 Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio B 50 Victoria Street, Aurora In this course for beginners and intermediates. Students will learn and play weekly song selections on the ukelele together as well as common chords, scales, techniques, and foundational principles of diatonic music. While song selections will be curated to match weekly lessons, students will also have the opportunity to request songs to learn and play together. Students must bring their own ukulele.
